description: Pre-start checks. Valves 9 and 15 dripping between fills.
action_taken: Reported. Seal change booked for tomorrow.
Shift lead told as per SOP 11.

description: Underfill alarm - Fill level low - bottles under target volume. Checkweigher report: valves 9 and 15 underfilling (491-494 ml).
action_taken: Pressed STOP. Valves 9 and 15 dripping. No maintenance on nights. Restarted and watched.

description: Second underfill alarm tonight. Same valves 9 and 15.
action_taken: Operator asked to raise the fill time to stop the underfill. Shift lead said no: fill time must not be changed (SOP 10, NCR-2026-012).

description: Third underfill alarm this shift. Valves 9, 15 and now 3 underfilling.
action_taken: Systemic fault (3 alarms in one shift). Production stopped. Maintenance work order raised. Maintenance supervisor called.

description: Line stopped since 04:45 for worn seals. Fill time left at 3.2 seconds.
action_taken: Seal change first thing on day shift.
